svg.title: Durability: A Handling Survives a Crash of Its Pod
svg.desc: A UML sequence diagram, read top to bottom, with two lifelines: the agent runtime and the record. The agent runtime writes each entry before the next step: received, attempt 1, then checked, the estimate and the proposal, then the Gate's decision. The pod crashes. On restart, the agent runtime reads the record back, the record returns the entries written so far, and the runtime counts a new attempt, attempt 2, and carries on from the first entry not written, the intent. A note says an intent with no outcome is never performed again, and the Operator is asked.
